source.author: hank2322

quote: Got one of these today when I disenchanted a random blue item while cleaning out my bank.
notes: One firsthand blue-item disenchant yielded one Radiant Shard on the output item's Wowhead page. Author explicitly calls it a pre-patch bug; input gear ID, expansion, item level, armor/weapon slot, bonus, output rank, enchant skill, specialization, and actual date unknown. This is a single prepatch cross-expansion reference-only observation, NOT an eligible Midnight current-patch baseline; no other material zero outcomes are established.
